Class ChessView

org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.games.chess.ChessView
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg.event.LgEventSource
public class ChessView extends org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg.Component3D
The chess board, rasterised into a single live texture with the same ImageComponent2D.set recipe as AgendaGrid / MailView.

Pieces are drawn as discs bearing a letter (K / Q / R / B / N / P) rather than the Unicode chess glyphs, which are not reliably present in a headless JRE's logical fonts. A left click maps the pick's local intersection to a board square and reports it through ChessView.SquareListener; the host drives selection and move-making and pushes highlight state back via

invalid reference 
#setSelected
,
invalid reference 
#setLegalTargets
and setFlipped(boolean). The view reads piece placement, the last move and check state straight from the model.
